question: The Umred-Pauni-Karhandla Sanctuary, is in ______.
solution: The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Umred-Pauni-Karhandla Wildlife Sanctuary** is located in the state of **Maharashtra**, India. It is situated near Nagpur and Chandrapur districts, making it easily accessible for wildlife enthusiasts. • This sanctuary is famous for being a habitat of the **Royal Bengal Tigers**. It serves as a crucial wildlife corridor linking the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve (TATR) and other nearby wildlife sanctuaries. • It is spread across an area of approximately **189 square kilometers**, featuring a mix of dense forests, grasslands, and water bodies, which provide a rich habitat for a variety of flora and fauna. • In addition to tigers, the sanctuary is home to several other species of wildlife, including **leopards, wild dogs (dholes), sloth bears, gaurs (Indian bison),** and a variety of birds and reptiles. • This sanctuary plays a significant role in tiger conservation under the **Project Tiger** initiative, which aims to protect and stabilize tiger populations in their natural habitat.
